items.title: What Could Derail CrowdStrike Stock?
items.summary: If you own CrowdStrike (CRWD), one worry stands out: did its best quarter come from a burst of AI urgency that will fade? Management called fiscal Q2 2027 the company's very best quarter. Over the last year, CrowdStrike stock returned 112%, against 18.0% for the S&P 500. A $10,000 holding a year ago is now worth about $21,200. Which threat could take that gain back.

items.summary: Palo Alto Networks and Fortinet shares are up 112% and 125% this year, respectively, as AI-driven demand for cybersecurity fuels strong earnings and technical breakouts for both stocks.

items.title: What Was Cisco Telling You Before Its Stock Ran?
items.summary: Cisco Systems (CSCO) stock returned 62% in the twelve months to September 24, 2026, against 16% for the S&P 500. A $10,000 holding at the start was worth about $16,220 at the end. The run was about AI data center orders from hyperscalers, the largest cloud companies. You could have read the run early only if two things held: Cisco was saying it, and its results were showing it.

items.title: Cybersecurity Stocks Pare Early-Week Gains — Analysts See AI Security Demand Building, But Valuations Raise The Bar
items.summary: Cybersecurity stocks are pulling back after a sharp early-week surge fueled by mounting AI safety concerns, while analysts say underlying security demand remains strong even as valuations have rerated higher.

items.title: How Much Could You Make If Synopsys Stock Rebounds From Here?
items.summary: Synopsys (SNPS) stock could climb about 25% before it reaches a level that has turned it back three times. It could fall about 5% before the floor it sits on gives way. On paper, that is a generous trade on a maker of chip-design software. The catch is the floor itself, which has a poor record over the past two years.
